closing.summary: Big strengths are fibre, works across a lot of cooking styles, and easy comfort-food base with less baggage than junk food, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin A, low iron, and low protein quality. It is good for practical meals, low-calorie flavour swaps, and digestion because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, the pros make it useful for adding flavour without much nutrition load, and fibre supports digestion and steadier meals.
